data.name: LIMINAL
data.detailed_description:
THE FOG HAS NO HORIZON.


LIMINAL is a first-person exploration and industrial-salvage game set in an infinite, seeded world. There is no map, quest log, or trail of objective markers. You learn the world by walking it.

COMMAND A WALKING INDUSTRY


Plant a Root Beacon and send six-legged harvesters into the fog. They cut into objects and foundations, return visible cargo, and divide large structures between them. Recover steel, copper, rubber, plastic, glass, stone, and intact machine components.

Merge three harvesters into a Walking Foundry, fabricate new machines, deploy relays to extend the network, and build Shaft Crawlers for deep excavation. Pick up the Root Beacon and your mobile fleet folds up to follow.

BRING DOWN MEGASTRUCTURES


Remove a structure's support and full-height sections break free, fall under physics, settle, and remain as harvestable wreckage. The ruin you create becomes the material for what comes next.

CROSS INTO 47 IMPOSSIBLE REALMS


Thresholds lead to 47 procedural realms with distinct terrain, architecture, materials, weather, skies, sound, and physical character: flooded museums, abandoned malls, impossible pools, black forests, lunar offices, snowbound stations, cloud cities, and places that resist easy description.

GET LOST ON PURPOSE


The same seed recreates the same land, but the world is not frozen. Fog travels, light moves, animals react, structures can return in different forms, and your machines keep working.

Four cathedral realms contain fully playable pipe organs with two manuals, pedals, sixteen drawstops, a working swell box, and 117 playable keys. They are not minigames. They are instruments left inside the world.

data.short_description: LIMINAL is a first-person exploration and industrial-salvage game set in an infinite world with no map and no horizon. Command walking machines, dismantle megastructures, and cross thresholds into 47 impossible realms.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Keyboard and mouse required. Intended for 1280×720 on Low settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6600 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD and current graphics drivers recommended. Intended for 1920×1080 on Medium settings.
